title.zh: 中国香港将于10月13日上市第二只现货Solana ETF
title.en: 中国香港将于10月13日上市第二只现货Solana ETF

current_state.zh: Hong Kong is set to list its second spot Solana ETF, Pando Solana ETF (2831.HK), on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13, with global spot SOL ETF net assets at $1.9 billion and cumulative net inflows of $1.61 billion.
